title: Shared schema conflict
description: Two independent tasks attempt to change the same database schema fixture.
constraints: This is a controlled conflict fixture.
The schema conflict is structural and deterministic.
acceptanceCriteria: One task changes user-facing schema fields.
Another task changes auth-related schema metadata.
Both tasks declare the same schema file.
The risk predictor marks the pair as high or blocking.
Risk-aware scheduling avoids naive parallel execution.
Human-gated mock review serializes blocking work.
expectedConflictNotes: Both tasks modify the same critical schema fixture.
